build_image_polyencoder_model: build an ImagePolyencoderModule model that encodes image features with context tokens
create_image_polyencoder_agent: create an ImagePolyencoderAgent that ingests image features and combines them with context embeddings
batchify_image_features: batchify image features in a Batch into a stacked Tensor for DataParallel training
review_image_combination_mode: review the ImagePolyencoderAgent image combination mode choices of add append or prepend
test_context_encoder_input: test the ImagePolyencoderModule context encoder input mapping tokens and image features
